derived_from.applied_state: 302 approved knowledge concepts after book-batch-12 completed chap08.

scope.single_batch_rationale: chap09 measures 211 prose lines against a B4 ceiling of 360 and yields 31 candidates against a B5 ceiling of 40. It needs no split.

namespace_decision.new_namespaces: kafka.pipeline.* for the eight data pipeline design considerations, kafka.connect.* for Kafka Connect itself.
namespace_decision.no_redefine_rule: messaging.pipeline.data-pipeline is already applied and carries what a data pipeline is. Batch 13 asserts what Kafka contributes to one and never redefines the pipeline; the preamble candidates relate to it instead.
namespace_decision.group_id_note: The connect worker's group.id is not given its own concept. kafka.config.group-id is applied for the consumer group id and a second concept with that title would collide outright, so the four core worker settings are carried as one kafka.connect.worker-configuration concept.

review_flag_policy.conflict: The candidate's evidence lies in the same domain as an applied concept that batch 13 touches, so U3 must confirm it relates rather than restates.
review_flag_policy.low-confidence: The cited span carries three or fewer prose lines, or the concept boundary is an authoring judgement over a container anchor.
review_flag_policy.provenance-warning: The evidence span is the pre-heading preamble with no heading chain, or an Obsidian callout.
review_flag_policy.sampling_note: Every flagged candidate must be fully sampled at U3.

alias_ownership_corrections.trigger: The first propose of this batch failed the collision gate with 3 title-or-alias collisions. Two applied concepts held aliases that name what chap09 gives its own concepts.
corrections: kafka.platform.platform-feature drops Kafka Connect and 카프카 커넥트. Those name the framework, which is now kafka.connect.kafka-connect. It keeps the Streams aliases, which it still owns.

kafka.reliability.error-handler-decision drops 백프레셔. Backpressure is one option a handler may take, not the handler decision itself, and chap09 defines it as its own concept at kafka.pipeline.backpressure.
alias_ownership_corrections.note: Both are alias moves only. Neither drops a source locator or a related-concept edge.

candidates.concept_granularity: single reliability requirement on a pipeline - avoid single points of failure and state the delivery guarantee - where Kafka gives at-least-once alone and exactly-once when paired with a destination that has transactions or unique keys

candidates.title: 조정 가능한 처리율
candidates.concept_granularity: single consequence of buffering: producer and consumer throughput stop being coupled, surplus accumulates in Kafka instead of needing a backpressure mechanism, and each side scales on its own

locators.heading: ## 데이터 파이프라인 구축 고려사항 > ### (3) 높으면서 조정 가능한 처리율

candidates.concept_granularity: single property that Kafka and the Connect API are indifferent to data format, holding records as in-memory objects with type and schema and leaving the wire format to a pluggable converter, so the choice of format does not constrain which connectors can be used

locators.heading: ## 데이터 파이프라인 구축 고려사항 > ### (4) 데이터 형식

candidates.title: 스키마 전파
candidates.concept_granularity: single practice of carrying the source's schema alongside the data so it can be used for compatibility checks and to update the sink's schema, with the sink connector owning the destination format

locators.heading: ## 데이터 파이프라인 구축 고려사항 > ### (4) 데이터 형식

candidates.title: ETL
candidates.concept_granularity: single pipeline shape that transforms data in transit, saving time and storage downstream but moving the compute and storage burden into the pipeline and making anything it drops unavailable to consumers

locators.heading: ## 데이터 파이프라인 구축 고려사항 > ### (5) 변환

candidates.title: ELT
candidates.concept_granularity: single pipeline shape delivering data as close to the original as possible and leaving transformation to the destination, maximizing the destination's flexibility at the cost of its CPU and resources

locators.heading: ## 데이터 파이프라인 구축 고려사항 > ### (5) 변환

candidates.title: SMT
candidates.concept_granularity: single stateless per-record transformation Connect applies in transit, usually without code, covering type casts, masking, filtering, flattening, header and field moves and topic rerouting, while stateful joins and aggregations need Kafka Streams

p6_resolution.statement: Ten applied concepts are touched by prose in chap09. None is re-proposed or restated; all ten receive a related_concepts edge.

touch_point_dispositions.evidence: The whole chapter is about data pipelines.
touch_point_dispositions.decision_rationale: The applied concept carries what a data pipeline is. Batch 13 asserts what Kafka contributes to one, and no candidate restates the definition.

touch_point_dispositions.evidence: L88-91 and L429-432 carry schemas alongside the data.
touch_point_dispositions.decision_rationale: The schema is applied; the new claim is that Connect propagates it.

touch_point_dispositions.evidence: Avro, JSON, Protobuf appear as converter formats.
touch_point_dispositions.decision_rationale: The formats are applied; converters are the new claim.

touch_point_dispositions.evidence: L55 states Kafka guarantees at-least-once on its own.
touch_point_dispositions.decision_rationale: Applied in batch 09; cited as the baseline a pipeline builds on.

touch_point_dispositions.evidence: L56-57 pairs Kafka with a transactional destination for exactly-once.
touch_point_dispositions.decision_rationale: Applied in batch 10; the pipeline claim points at it.

touch_point_dispositions.evidence: L445-451 uses a logical offset defined by the origin system.
touch_point_dispositions.decision_rationale: The Kafka offset is applied; Connect's logical offset is explicitly not it, which the granularity records.

touch_point_dispositions.evidence: Kafka Connect and Kafka Streams are named throughout.
touch_point_dispositions.decision_rationale: The applied concept already names both; batch 13 details Connect rather than restating the feature list.

touch_point_dispositions.evidence: L120 and L369 send joins and aggregations to Kafka Streams.
touch_point_dispositions.decision_rationale: Cited as the boundary of what SMT can do.

touch_point_dispositions.evidence: L67 scales producer and consumer sides independently.
touch_point_dispositions.decision_rationale: Scalability is applied; this is a pipeline consequence of it.

touch_point_dispositions.evidence: L142 relies on long retention to rewind and repair.
touch_point_dispositions.decision_rationale: Retention is applied; the recovery affordance is the new claim.
